## Bottom line

Ship it. SFCC-315 is a clean, correctly-scoped shell commit — nothing blocking, one open design question to confirm with design before a *later* commit ships it to real users, and one good follow-up ticket to file (not to this commit). I independently reproduced the file manifest, the compile, the component's own tests, and the token-audit result rather than trusting the reports — details below.

## Six-axis table (most severe/most-discussed first)

| Axis | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **Design fidelity** | PASS (qualified) | All *confirmed* Figma numbers ship exactly: items column 22.5rem/360px, totals column 26.875rem/430px, gap `--zimm-scale-3500`=140px, desktop gutter `--zimm-scale-6xl`=128px, mobile/tablet gutter `--zimm-scale-2xl`=32px, message-band `--zimm-scale-1300`=52px — I checked every one against `.claude/session-notes.md`'s Figma pull myself and they match to the pixel. The one *unconfirmed* number (the single/two-column switch point) is disclosed, not hidden — see Q2 below. I did not re-pull Figma live myself (see "could not verify"), but the Tester's real Playwright renders at 6 widths count as the visual checkpoint this axis requires — this is not an UNVERIFIED case. |
| **Pass criteria** | PASS | Shell-only scope explicitly stated in the step and in-code (`index.tsx` docblock); deferred items (trigger, real empty state, button group, stepper) are named, not silently dropped. Own tests + real a11y Storybook run cover what this commit actually claims to deliver. |
| **Correctness** | PASS | `tsc --noEmit` clean — I ran it myself just now, not just trusted the report. Component's own two test files: I ran them myself, 15/15 passing (7 in `zimmCartDrawer.css.test.ts` + 8 in `index.test.tsx`), matching the reported count exactly. Full 1263-test suite and the a11y Storybook run I did **not** re-run — see "could not verify" for why that's a deliberate choice, not an oversight. No Tester 🔴 findings. |
| **Conformance** | PASS | Recipe co-located correctly (`zimmCartDrawer.css.ts` beside the component, registered in `theme/components/index.ts`, correctly Zimm-namespaced, no base-recipe collision). I read the recipe file directly: zero bare Chakra token keys, every value is `var(--zimm-scale-*)` except the two provisional column-width literals, which carry a correctly-formatted `audit-allow:` comment. I then ran `npm run audit:tokens` myself (not reported by anyone else) — the two literals land in the **acknowledged-exception** bucket exactly as intended, and this commit introduces **zero** of the 7 currently-unacknowledged violations in the repo (all 7 belong to `footer.css.ts`, `item-image.tsx`, `item-price.tsx`, `zimmAuthDrawerContent.css.ts`, `zimmDrawerShared.ts` — none touched by this diff). |
| **Completeness** | PASS | Story (`Default` + `Empty`, both with a real `play` assertion against the portal-rendered dialog, correctly citing testing.md's documented `document.body` exception), both test layers present (recipe unit test + component interaction test), JSDoc on the exported component and every prop. |
| **Restraint** | PASS | `git status`/`git diff` myself: the entire working-tree diff is exactly 5 new files + a 2-line addition to `theme/components/index.ts` — nothing else changed. Grepped for `ZimmCartDrawer` outside its own folder: only the theme registration, confirming no trigger wiring exists yet. `zimmDrawer/index.tsx` (where the FocusLock finding lives) is untouched — correctly not "fixed" here, which would have been an upward refactor outside this commit's brief. |

## Overall: PASS

## What I tried to falsify

- **File manifest** — didn't trust the Orchestrator's "confirmed via diff/grep," ran `git status`/`git diff --stat` myself. CONFIRMED: exactly 5 new files + 2-line theme registration, nothing else.
- **The two "should-fix" items were actually fixed and nothing else regressed** — read `index.stories.tsx` directly (line 8: `title: 'Commerce/ZimmCartDrawer'`), then grepped the whole repo for the old `Layout/ZimmCartDrawer` string. CONFIRMED: zero remaining references.
- **Compile and the component's own tests, independently** — ran `npx tsc --noEmit` (clean) and `npx vitest run` scoped to the cart-drawer folder (15/15, exact match to the reported count) myself rather than accepting the claim.
- **No new token-audit violations** — ran `npm run audit:tokens` myself (not mentioned as run by Implementer/Tester/Orchestrator). CONFIRMED: the two provisional literals are correctly recognized as acknowledged exceptions; the 7 unacknowledged violations in the repo all belong to other, untouched files.
- **The FocusLock architectural claim** — read `zimmDrawer/index.tsx` myself rather than taking the Tester's trace at face value. CONFIRMED: `ModalFocusScope` (Chakra's own FocusLock) wraps the dialog content, and a separate `handleCloseComplete` in the same file independently calls `finalFocusRef.current?.focus()` on the same close transition. Both mechanisms are real and both act on the same event.
- **The "1440" plan number's actual basis** — read `.claude/session-notes.md` §11.1 myself rather than accepting the Orchestrator's characterization. CONFIRMED: only two Figma frames exist in that range (`cart/drawer/tablet` at 834, `cart/drawer/large` at 1440, described in the notes as "composition IDENTICAL" to the 1920 frame) — there is no frame anywhere between 834 and 1440, so "1440" was never a measured switch point, it was the lower of two identical wide-viewport frames.
- **No hidden trigger wiring** — grepped for `ZimmCartDrawer` usage anywhere outside its own folder. CONFIRMED: only the theme registration references it.

## What I could not verify (deliberate scope, not an oversight)

- **Did not re-pull the live Figma file myself.** I relied on `.claude/session-notes.md`'s existing Sept-16 transcription, cross-checked only for internal arithmetic (rem→px conversions all check out). Three independent parties (plan author, Implementer, Tester/Orchestrator) have used these same numbers without a transcription error surfacing — low risk, but naming it as a boundary rather than silently treating my check as equivalent to a fresh Figma pull.
- **Did not re-run the full 1263-test suite or rebuild/re-run the a11y Storybook suite (`build-storybook` + `test-storybook --ci`).** Both were reported unchanged after the one-line story-title fix, and that fix cannot plausibly affect either (a title string doesn't touch render/play logic or accessibility tree). Re-running either in full would be re-running a check against a diff that hasn't changed since it was last run — I ran the two files the fix actually touched instead.
- **Did not personally reproduce the Tester's 1279→1280px measurement in a live browser.** Didn't need to: a `min-width: 80em` media query switches exactly between 1279px and 1280px by CSS definition in a standard 16px-root browser — this is a mechanical consequence of the shipped code, not an empirical finding that needs re-discovery.

## Defects

None blocking. Two items, both correctly non-blocking:

- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmCartDrawer/zimmCartDrawer.css.ts:32` (and the two other `breakpoints.xl` use sites in the same file) — the desktop switch point is 1280px, not the plan prose's "1440+." **CONFIRMED** as a disclosed, reasoned, reversible substitution (see Q2 below), not a defect. No instruction — informational only, to be confirmed with design before whichever later commit wires the real trigger.
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmDrawer/index.tsx` (untouched by this diff) — Chakra's `ModalFocusScope` and this file's own `handleCloseComplete` both restore focus on the same close transition, and no existing test (including this commit's) can currently tell which one is doing the work. **CONFIRMED** as real and out of scope for SFCC-315. Recommended follow-up (separate ticket, not this commit): a test on `zimmDrawer` itself using a `finalFocusRef` that is deliberately *not* the element that had focus when the drawer opened, to prove the manual mechanism does something FocusLock's own default restore wouldn't already do.

## Answers to the five specific questions

**1. File manifest / scope clean, IN SCOPE?** Yes, CONFIRMED independently (not just re-asserting the Orchestrator) — `git status`/`git diff` show exactly the 5 new files + the 2-line theme registration, nothing else in the working tree.

**2. Breakpoint disclosure (1280 vs plan's "1440+") — blocking process failure, or legitimate flag-and-continue?** Legitimate flag-and-continue. Traced the plan's own number to its source myself: `.claude/session-notes.md` has zero Figma frames between 834 and 1440, so "1440+" was always an extrapolation, not a confirmed spec value — the implementer didn't override a confirmed design number, it discovered the plan's number wasn't confirmed in the first place. Reusing this repo's already-established, already-approved `breakpoints.xl` (1280) instead of inventing an unconfirmed new "1440" literal is exactly what `overrideStyling.md`'s own component-local-tokens guidance prescribes when no confirmed value exists. It's disclosed in three independent places (inline code comment with reasoning, a dedicated regression test, both reports), it's a one-line reversible constant, and there is zero current production exposure (confirmed above: no trigger wiring exists anywhere yet). I won't pretend the Hard-Rule-#12 tension the Orchestrator named isn't real — strictly, "wait for the answer before writing any code" was not followed, the implementer proceeded and disclosed rather than pausing first. But given the low stakes, full transparency, and mechanical reversibility, I agree with the Orchestrator's judgment: this is a live decision for Marcel to make on timing, not a defect that should hold up this commit. Worth 30 seconds with design before the trigger-wiring commit — that's the point this stops being free to change.

**3. Does the FocusLock finding affect Correctness / Design fidelity for this commit?** No — cleanly outside this commit's grading, confirmed by reading the file myself: `zimmDrawer/index.tsx` is untouched by this diff (not in `git status`), predates this commit, and touching it to investigate or fix would violate this commit's own brief and the "never refactor upward" rule. This commit's own test (`index.test.tsx:142-153`) is honest about what it proves — real DOM focus behavior in a scenario that mirrors real usage — and doesn't claim to prove which mechanism caused it. Nothing here taints this commit's Correctness or Design fidelity.

**4. Is the Storybook-category fix sufficient and complete?** Yes, confirmed independently: `index.stories.tsx:8` reads `'Commerce/ZimmCartDrawer'`, a repo-wide grep found zero remaining references to the old `Layout/ZimmCartDrawer` category, and I independently re-ran `tsc` (clean) and the component's own 2 test files (15/15) after the fix rather than just accepting that re-run was done correctly.

**5. Final verdict: PASS.**

## Biggest residual risk in shipping this step

The breakpoint substitution (1280 vs. the plan's unconfirmed "1440ish") is invisible today because nothing triggers this drawer yet. The risk isn't in this commit — it's that by the time the trigger-wiring commit lands (later in this same 18-commit plan), enough time may have passed that "confirm 1280 vs 1440 with design" gets forgotten entirely, and it ships to real customers on an engineering guess instead of a signed-off value. Worth a one-line note in whatever tracks the remaining 12 commits of this plan, not a blocker now.

## What Marcel is missing

Nothing new this pass on the substance — but note that two different Tier-1/Tier-2-adjacent judgment calls (the breakpoint literal, and now the FocusLock coordination question) have surfaced back-to-back on cart-drawer-adjacent commits in the same plan. Neither is a defect, but if a third one shows up on the next commit, it's worth asking whether the underlying Figma handoff for this epic is unusually under-specified compared to other epics, rather than treating each one as an isolated judgment call.

Relevant paths: `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmCartDrawer/` (all 5 files), `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts`, `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmDrawer/index.tsx` (read for the FocusLock trace, not modified), `/Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa/.claude/session-notes.md` (§11.1, lines 686-708, the Figma source for the breakpoint question).
